notes:
Origin: inbound from sales enablement/call-summary tool stack (using Fireflies for capture). SMB lead ~70 employees focused on sales coaching + agent assist. Wants hosted API and self-serve path but needs clarity on PII handling and retention rules.

Key ask: automatic transcript redaction (PII masking), configurable retention windows (30/90/365 days), export APIs for customers, and audit logs for access. Concern: transcripts often include SSNs and credit-card-like strings from demos — need guarantee of masking or deletion.

Quotes: "We need to make sure customer PII never persists longer than necessary — legal will push back otherwise." "Prefer hosted but want simple controls in the Console for retention and redaction."

Technical constraints: Public cloud ok, no on-prem now. Prefer SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning. Interested in tokenization options for transcripts and KMS-backed encryption for workspace-level keys.

Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; likely start with low usage POC (monthly ARR in 10k-25k range if privacy controls are sufficient). Evaluating against Otter/Fireflies + potential open-source self-host.

Next steps: Send security FAQ and redaction/retention docs (Ava). Schedule SE-led POC to demo retention toggles and show latency/throughput for 2 concurrent agents (Marco).
